groups.name: easygram.telegram-url
groups.description: Optional override for the Telegram Bot API server URL. Use when running a self-hosted or local Bot API server. All fields are optional — omit the entire block to use the official api.telegram.org endpoint.

properties.name: easygram.token
properties.description: Telegram Bot API token from @BotFather. Required for all transports.

properties.name: easygram.update.transport
properties.description: Update-delivery transport. LONG_POLLING (default) polls Telegram getUpdates API; WEBHOOK receives updates via HTTPS endpoint; KAFKA_CONSUMER and RABBIT_CONSUMER consume from a broker; NONE suppresses all automatic transports.

properties.name: easygram.telegram-url.schema
properties.description: URL schema for the Bot API server (e.g. 'https', 'http'). Null keeps the default schema used by the official Telegram URL.

properties.name: easygram.telegram-url.host
properties.description: Hostname of a self-hosted or local Bot API server. When null, the official api.telegram.org host is used. Set this to redirect all Bot API calls to your own server.

properties.name: easygram.telegram-url.port
properties.description: Port of the Bot API server. Null keeps the default port for the chosen schema. Typically 443 for HTTPS or 8443 for self-hosted servers.

properties.name: easygram.telegram-url.test-server
properties.description: Whether to target the Telegram test environment (test.telegram.org). Use during development to avoid affecting production data. Defaults to false.

values.description: Poll Telegram getUpdates API (default). No public URL required.
Receive updates via an HTTPS webhook endpoint. Requires easygram.update.webhook.url.
Consume Telegram updates from a Kafka topic. Requires spring-kafka and easygram.messaging.kafka.* settings.
Consume Telegram updates from a RabbitMQ queue. Requires spring-boot-starter-amqp and easygram.messaging.rabbit.* settings.
No automatic transport started. Use when the application manages its own update ingestion (e.g. an in-memory queue).
